mods.name: EasyBlockEditor
mods.description:
EasyBlockEditor is a building editor mod inspired by Litematica, developed with the LDLib2 framework.
It serves as both a building editor and a building management platform.
Core concept: Provide an in-game full-screen 3D UI editor, allowing players to design, edit, manage, and share buildings in a non-destructive way.
Enjoy the fun of immersive building editing and collaboration!

EasyBlockEditor 是一个受 Litematica 启发、基于 LDLib2 框架开发的建筑编辑模组。
它既是建筑编辑器，也是建筑管理与协作平台。
核心理念：在游戏内提供全屏 3D UI 编辑器，让玩家以非破坏性的方式设计、编辑、管理和共享建筑。
享受沉浸式建筑编辑与多人协作的乐趣！

releases.notes:
## 新增
- **开屏动画**:首次打开编辑器时播放着色器驱动的多阶段开场动画(暗场渐入 → 扫描线扫描 → LOGO 去马赛克渐显 → CRT 撕裂 → 文字光线扫描 → 粒子溶解消失)。
- 可在 **设置 > 通用 > 开屏动画** 中选择播放时机:每次开启 / 每次启动首次 / 仅首次启动 / 始终关闭(默认:仅首次启动)。
- 播放时点击或按任意键可跳过。

## 其他
- 工作组使用独立图标。

releases.notes:
## EasyBlockEditor v0.1.5

### Performance: Large Projection Rendering Overhaul

- **Multi-threaded MDI compilation** (N-1 CPU cores): 6.35M block projections compile in ~5 seconds on 11 threads
- **Direct model scan**: Bypasses the slow per-frame loading pipeline entirely
- **Face culling**: Skips internal faces between adjacent opaque blocks, reducing vertex count by 60-80%
- **Cluster-based VBO architecture**: Blocks grouped into 64x64x64 regions with independent VBOs and distance-based LOD
- **Distance LOD rendering**: Full detail within 1024 blocks, Shell LOD beyond 2048 (both configurable)
- **Progressive cluster upload**: 2 clusters uploaded per frame to avoid GPU stalls
- **BlockState resolution cache**: Identical block type strings parsed only once
- **O(1) block dedup**: addBlockToSection uses LongOpenHashSet instead of O(n) list scan

### New Features

- **Entity delete button**: When a decorative entity is selected, a Delete Entity button appears in the properties panel
- **MDI render distance settings**: Full Detail Distance and LOD Distance added to viewport performance settings
- **Reset to Defaults button**: One-click reset for all viewport performance settings
- **No artificial block cap**: Large projections load all blocks without the previous 1M limit

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed block placement not refreshing MDI render (dirty cluster recompilation)
- Fixed small projections (<1MB) incorrectly triggering the large projection pipeline
- Fixed exactCap=1000000 blocking loading beyond 1M blocks
- Sync load threshold raised to 1.0 MB default

### Requirements

- NeoForge 1.21.1
- LowDragLib2 2.2.6+

## EasyBlockEditor 0.1.3-beta

This beta focuses on server-side loading safety and huge projection stability.

### Changes
- Fixed dedicated server startup crash caused by common item/mod initialization touching client-only Minecraft classes.
- Added a common-side client bridge so server class loading no longer resolves `net.minecraft.client.*` UI classes.
- Kept the huge projection viewport stabilization from M6: no eager full projection precompute for large viewport loads, bounded LOD sampling, and lightweight preview fallback for extreme projections.

### Verification
- `./gradlew.bat clean build --console=plain` passed.

releases.notes:
## EasyBlockEditor 0.1.2-beta

This beta focuses on large projection stability, smoother viewport behavior, and release-readiness fixes.

### Highlights
- Add the first Mega Projection RenderCore foundation with sparse section storage, LOD pyramid data, greedy LOD meshing, section mesh caching, and render scheduling.
- Improve large projection viewport loading paths and reduce retained computed projection memory for large files.
- Keep small projections on the synchronous viewport path according to the configured size threshold.
- Fix projection history and branch persistence mixing between different source files by isolating history files by source path identity.
- Fix oversized dialog layouts for large projection warnings, layer merge, branch, version tag, NBT diff, and material diff flows.
- Stop printers automatically and unload the projection after placement completion across Place All, manual printing, auto printing, material chest printing, and workgroup printing.
- Add localized completion feedback for projection placement.

### Build
- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- NeoForge: 21.1.218
- Version: 0.1.2-beta
